author: National Geographic
description:
Ahead of the 2026 Milano-Cortina Olympics, Stanley Tucci and National Geographic explore the pioneering spirit of Italy’s industrial heartland, the Lombardy region, where the cuisine and ingredients are defiantly forward-thinking. Stanley Tucci tries vegan food at Autogrill, explores a caviar farm, and makes gnocchi with a family navigating adoption policies.
